description: Curated ScreenHand reference for competitor research on Meta Ad Library using the India all-ads flow.

steps: Open Meta Ad Library with ad_type=all and country=IN
Search by advertiser or page name, not by a generic keyword
Click the advertiser suggestion row so Meta resolves view_all_page_id
Read result count, Library IDs, launch dates, and repeated snippets
guards: Prefer advertiser lookup before keyword search
Keep ad_type=all in the URL or Meta may fall back to political_and_issue_ads
advertiser_lookup.why: Advertiser pages are the cleanest outside signal for active Meta campaign families and message repetition.

steps: Run 3-5 market keywords after advertiser lookup
Use keyword search only to discover new competitors and angles
Treat repeated hooks across brands as stronger evidence than one creative
guards: Keyword search undercounts brands whose copy avoids the keyword
keyword_crosscheck.why: Keyword searches help with discovery, but advertiser pages are still the higher-signal validation path.

errors.error: fresh tabs can reopen in political_and_issue_ads mode
errors.context: Meta resets filters on some new sessions and links
errors.solution: Always start from a URL that already contains ad_type=all and country=IN.

errors.context: Queries like psychometric can miss brands whose copy leads with career clarity, exam stress, parent pressure, or DMIT
errors.solution: Use advertiser or page lookup first, then keyword search as a market cross-check.
